About Genius AI

Genius AI is building technology to help local businesses run themselves. Genius AI products do the admin work that keeps practitioners from the work they love and the people they serve. From GlossGenius to Reception, its products work 24/7 on busywork like booking, marketing, client management, finances, staff and inventory management, and more.

Genius AI technology has saved businesses 106M in admin hours, earned them $2.0B in additional revenue, and facilitated more than 624M client touch points.

About the Role

As we continue to expand our reach and impact, we are seeking highly motivated and talented engineering interns to join our team for Summer of 2027.

Position: Engineering Intern

Location: NYC

Duration: June 8th 2027 to August 20th 2027

This internship puts you inside a live engineering team shipping product that hundreds of thousands of service businesses and their clients touch every day. You'll work on real features headed to production, not a side project built to keep you busy. Genius AI is scaling an agentic product at a pace where decisions ship in days, and this role exists so you get real exposure to how that speed and judgment work together.

You will report to an engineering manager on our team. You must be commutable to our NYC headquarters in Union Square, and will operate in an in-person environment. We default to being in-office 3-4 days per week with required attendance on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

What You'll Do

- Build and test features for our web and mobile products alongside senior engineers, shaping experiences used by our customers and their clients

- Architect small pieces of automation with AI, not just use it as an assistant: identify repeatable work in your own project and build the system that removes it

- Write clean, efficient code that meets Genius AI engineering standards, and own debugging and troubleshooting

- Partner with data analysts to collect and interpret usage data, and use those insights to inform how AI gets applied across the product

- Ship fast, learn faster: iterate on your projects with AI-assisted development on a tight cadence, adjusting based on feedback from senior engineers

- Expand your technical range deliberately, picking up new languages, frameworks, and AI-native development practices as the team's needs shift

What We're Looking For

- Currently pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science or related technical field, graduating between 2027 and 2028, with coursework or project experience in software engineering

- You use AI to learn faster, debug, and ship, and can point to something you've built with it

- You dig into a problem before waiting for someone to hand you the answer, and you ask for help once you're stuck, not before you've tried

- Proficient in one or more of JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, or Kotlin, with real project experience beyond coursework

- Comfortable picking up new frameworks and tools quickly, ideally with some exposure to React, Postgres, SQL, or gRPC

- Strong problem-solving instincts and equally comfortable working independently or pairing with a teammate

- Clear, direct communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non-engineers

- Available to work in person from our Union Square, NYC office

At Genius AI, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. We believe this benefits not only our employees but our product, customers, and community as well. Genius AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer.

You'll work with engineers and operators to automate repetitive tasks, organize operational data, and prototype useful AI-powered tools. Projects will be scoped for a part-time, temporary assignment, with priorities and feedback from the team.

- Build and improve Python scripts and lightweight internal tools that reduce manual work.

- Use LLM APIs and other AI tools to help teams find information and automate workflows.

- Connect APIs, databases, and internal systems to make information easier to access and use.

- Clean and analyze engineering and field data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, and ground uplift.

- Create simple dashboards and reports to help the team track performance.

- Test your work, document how to use it, and improve it based on feedback from engineers and operators.

What We're Looking For

- Ability to work in person in Berkeley on a part-time schedule for a temporary assignment.

- Working knowledge of Python and evidence that you can build and debug a useful script or application.

- Some hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI tools, or workflow automation through coursework, personal projects, or prior work.

- Basic familiarity with APIs, databases, SQL, or data analysis tools such as Pandas.

- Willingness to work with messy real-world data, ask questions, and learn from feedback.

- Familiarity with time-series data, sensors, equipment telemetry, or applied machine learning.

- Interest in mechanical systems, industrial automation, or engineering data.

Why Terranova?

You'll build tools that engineers and operators use in their daily work, get direct feedback from the team, and see how software and AI support real physical systems.

We prepare talented individuals to work with AWS's most influential and strategic customers, helping them transform their businesses on the AWS Cloud.

Program Overview:

Our program offers a 3-month mentorship where you will:

- Learn how to drive technical solutions on the AWS Cloud in collaboration with the AWS Solution Architect team

- Understand how to engage with customers and deliver value from the AWS engagement and build the trust of our customers

- Develop skills to lead customer engagements and drive technical and business strategy discussions

- Work alongside experienced professionals who will guide your development

- Work on AWS Services and AWS AI Tools to enhance your skills.

Location Details: Seattle, WA

Start Date Details: This is a cohort-based program where everyone is required to start on the same day. The start date is tentatively set for June 21st, 2027.

What You'll Do:
As part of your internship, you may:

- Engage directly on actual business challenges

- Gain hands-on experience building on the AWS cloud

- Apply AWS services and architectural best practices in real-world scenarios

- Develop technical and business acumen through working backwards from actual customer problems

- Work with mentors to build and implement solutions for actual business needs

- Prepare for a role advising AWS's most strategic and influential customers through practical experience

What Sets Our Program Apart:
Unlike other development programs that focus primarily on classroom training, our internship program provides:

- Immediate hands-on experience involving real customer needs

- Direct engagement opportunities throughout your development

- Practical application of your skills in actual business environments

- Real-world problem solving

Key job responsibilities
- Create solutions that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services

- Interface with customer stakeholders, including developers and team leads

- Drive effective feedback gathering from customers, distill and translate feedback into clear business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams

- Drive business outcomes through technology adoption

- Advise customers on cloud strategy, digital transformation, or Gen AI/Agentic strategy

About the team
The Emerging Talent team within AWS Industries and Strategic Accounts develops the next generation of field-ready talent (Solutions Architects, Customer Solutions Managers, and sales professionals) who work with some of the largest, most influential customers across a variety of industries. We take a cohort-based approach to talent development and provide new builders the resources (education, mentorship, job shadow opportunities) to thrive in a customer-facing role.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
- Experience developing and delivering presentations to large and diverse audiences
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Technical depth in one or more areas: cloud migrations, application modernization, data & analytics, infrastructure optimization, security & compliance, or AI/ML/Gen AI/Agentic
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into executive-level narratives
- Familiarity with Generative AI / Agentic AI concepts with the ability to facilitate strategic conversations on GenAI use cases, adoption frameworks, and business impact
- Experience managing a portfolio of complex, high-value workloads across industry verticals
- Currently in the process of obtaining, a bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field with a conferral date between December 2027 and September 2028
- Must be 18 or older

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution in a school project or while working for a company
- Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with external customers, resulting in measurable business outcomes (revenue growth, workload expansion, executive sponsorship)
- AWS Associate-level certification(s) or above.
